note: Use incidence counting to cover loops: for endpoint v_m distinct from v_0, each internal occurrence contributes two used incidences and the final occurrence one, hence odd. Maximality says every incident edge is used, contradicting even degree. For edge-spanning, let S be vertices of the closed trail. Connectedness plus any omitted edge yields an omitted edge f incident with S; rotate the cyclic trail at that incidence and append f.
